acceptanceCriteria: Selection over a bound application repository uses an impact graph pinned to that repository's commit.
Tests show an indirect application change narrowing, and an unresolved one still selecting the full suite.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1675 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1102, head f58754780, AFU-V1-067..072); recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-V1-1675-e2e-separate-repository.md Limits. Expected: a change in an application-repo file that reaches a linked application file only through imports narrows selection like a same-repo change. Actual: it is e2e-unmapped-change and selects the full relevant suite (safe but coarse; AFU-V1-070 non-goal).
title: affected e2e-safe: no impact graph over a bound application repository, so indirect application changes select the full suite
